name: jev-1.13-mini-bench
notes: Labels are author-assigned ground truth. 'clear': true = label follows strongly from the text; false = borderline judgment call. Criterion wording fixes the label semantics.

is_urgent.instructions: Does this message require action within the next few hours?

criteria.true: Ongoing harm, outage, deadline today or tomorrow, or the writer explicitly needs immediate action
criteria.false: The matter can reasonably wait a day or more; no stated deadline and no active harm

department.instructions: Which team should handle this message?

criteria.billing: Payments, invoices, refunds, charges, plan or subscription changes
criteria.technical: Bugs, outages, errors, integrations, product not working
criteria.sales: Pricing questions for new or larger purchases, demos, enterprise evaluation
criteria.other: Requests that fit none of the other teams, such as data export or account closure logistics
